note: Illicit-class F1 on the Elliptic Bitcoin dataset (203,769 transactions, 49 biweekly time steps, 2% labeled illicit). Snapshot of Weber et al. 2019 (arXiv:1908.02591, Table 1) and Maganti 2026 (arXiv:2604.19514, Tables 5–7, 9, 10), taken 2026-06-12.

modes.label: 2019 paper
modes.title: The original Elliptic paper (Weber et al. 2019) · AF features · temporal label split, full-graph GNN training
modes.insight: The benchmark that launched a thousand GNN papers reported a tree winning by 16 F1 points — RF precision 0.956 vs GCN 0.812.

modes.label: 2026 inductive
modes.title: Leakage-free re-evaluation (Maganti 2026) · train steps 1–34, test 35–49, no test-period edges seen in training
modes.insight: Under a strict inductive temporal protocol every GNN trails both tree ensembles; GraphSAGE, the best GNN, sits 13.3 points below the forest.

modes.label: four graphs
modes.title: The same GraphSAGE, varying only what graph it trains on (Maganti 2026, Tables 9–10)
modes.insight: Seeing test-period edges in training costs 39.5 F1 points — and randomly rewired edges beat the real transaction topology by 9.

bars.label: full graph
bars.detail: precision 0.182 · recall 0.765 · paired gap −0.395 F1, p ≈ 2.6×10⁻¹²

bars.label: full graph, shuffled edges
bars.detail: beats the real topology by +0.089 F1

bars.label: no edges at all
bars.detail: still +0.025 F1 over the real topology

modes.label: step-43 cliff
modes.title: GraphSAGE F1 per test step (steps reported in Maganti 2026, Table 7) — dark-market shutdowns hit at step 43
modes.insight: The labeled illicit rate collapses 11.1% → 0.3% after coordinated dark-market shutdowns; F1 drops to 0.016 and never recovers.

bars.label: step 49
bars.detail: precision 0.020 · recall 0.040 · base rate returns, the model doesn't
